Problem Analysis & Need 02 / 10

The Industrial Safety Crisis & Human Monitoring Breakdown

Why manual safety inspections and passive CCTV surveillance fail to protect workforce lives.

⚠️ The Grim Global Reality
  • 2.78 Million Fatalities: Over 7,600 workers die daily worldwide from occupational accidents & diseases (ILO).
  • 374 Million Non-Fatal Injuries: Severe fractures, head traumas, and falls causing permanent disability.
  • $150B+ Annual Cost: Astronomical liabilities in medical expenses, OSHA fines, and manufacturing shutdowns.
💡 84% of fatalities are preventable with immediate PPE gear & hazard intervention.
👁️ Human Fatigue & Blindspots
  • 85% Attention Loss: Studies prove human CCTV operators miss >85% of video activity after only 20 minutes of continuous monitoring.
  • Passive & Forensic: Legacy CCTV is recording history for post-mortem investigations rather than stopping active disasters.
  • Manual Clipboard Audits: Periodic EHS spot-checks only inspect 1-2% of worker-hours; unequipped workers slip through unnoticed.
💡 Fatigued security staff cannot monitor 16+ camera feeds simultaneously.
🚀 The SafeVision AI Paradigm Shift
  • Sub-100ms Edge Intervention: Instantly catches missing helmets, unattached harnesses, and fire sparks in real time.
  • Autonomous Physical Deterrence: Direct hardware siren horn & spoken voice alerts warn workers on the spot.
  • Zero Blindspot Coverage: Continuous multi-camera tracking with automated digital compliance audit logs.
💡 Transforms reactive investigation into autonomous real-time prevention.
CORE MISSION OBJECTIVE
Deliver zero workplace fatalities through edge neural computer vision, instant acoustic deterrence, and automated EHS governance.

System Architecture & Pipeline 03 / 10

Distributed Edge Architecture & Multi-Device Deployment

Affordable, zero-lag edge hardware ecosystem linking mobile cameras, inference servers, and control rooms.

📱 Node 1: Mobile Camera
Wireless or USB Sensor Node
  • DroidCam Wi-Fi Mode: Cordless IP camera mobility across active plant floors.
  • Zero-Lag USB Mode: Direct ADB tethering achieving 30-40 FPS ultra-smooth video.
  • RTSP Industrial CCTV: Plugs into existing Axis, Hikvision, and Dahua cameras.
IP: http://192.168.x.x:4747
💻 Node 2: AI Edge Engine
Laptop 1 (Inference Unit)
  • Dual Neural Engines: YOLOv8 detection + YOLO11-Pose keypoints in parallel.
  • Unified CameraManager: Shared inference prevents redundant GPU/CPU load.
  • Spatial Trackers: Confined space polygons, trench setback lines, drop zones.
Latency: ~24ms / frame
💻 Node 3: Command Center
Laptop 2 (Safety Officer)
  • Real-Time EHS Dashboard: Low-latency MJPEG video with bounding boxes & HUD.
  • Zone Switchboard: Instant camera switching across Zone 1, Zone 2, etc.
  • Remote Overrides: Mute sirens, toggle modules, adjust sensitivity on the fly.
Port: :8000 / WebSockets
🔊 Node 4: Siren Speaker
Physical Audio Deterrence
  • Industrial Siren Tones: 18 distinct acoustic winsound frequency patterns.
  • TTS Voice Announcer: Speaks spoken instructions directly to violators.
  • Async Audio Queue: Background thread eliminates video stream stutter.
Output: 3.5mm Aux / BT
🎥
Live Multi-Zone Camera Command Hub
Dynamic `ZoneCameraManager` coordinates 4 simultaneous live CCTV camera feeds: PPE Entry Gate, Scaffolding Heights, Crane Drop Zones, and Hot Work Welding Bays with active AI bounding boxes at 27+ FPS.
📁 Zone 1: Main Floor 📁 Zone 2: Scaffolding ● 4 LIVE FEEDS ACTIVE ⚡ YOLO11-NANO ~37MS

OSHA 1926 Subpart M & Confined Space
Construction Engineering AI 05 / 10

Advanced Construction AI: Heights, Cranes & Confined Spaces

Engineered specifically for heavy civil construction sites, scaffolding, and dangerous hoisting zones.

🏗️ OSHA 1926 Subpart M
Height Safety & Harness Watch
  • Elevated Deck Detection: Monitors workers on scaffolding, high beams, and ladders.
  • Harness Strap Verification: Neural validation of full-body harness straps & dorsal D-rings.
  • Anchored Lifeline Check: Alerts if worker is elevated without anchored safety tether.
  • Critical Audio Blare: "Critical Warning: Fall arrest harness mandatory at height!"
📦 360° Radar Drop Zone
Crane Load "Drop Zone" Radar
  • Hoisted Cargo Tracking: Detects suspended steel beams, crane hooks, and precast slabs.
  • Dynamic Drop Shadow: Computes rotating 360° radar drop circle directly beneath load.
  • Line-of-Fire Clear Zone: Alerts workers stepping into the crush zone under the load.
  • Pulsed Siren Horn: "Danger! Stand clear of crane suspended load drop zone!"
🚪 Portal Headcount & Timer
Confined Space Safe Stay-Timer
  • Portal Boundary Tracking: Tracks entry/exit polygon across manholes, tanks, and silos.
  • Bidirectional Headcount: Real-time tally of active workers inside vs exited.
  • Stay-Timer Countdown: Warns when safe oxygen stay time (e.g., 45 mins) is exceeded.
  • Asphyxiation Prevention: Eliminates fatalities caused by toxic gas buildup.
🏗️ Targeting OSHA's "Fatal Four": Falls (36.5%), Struck-By (15.4%), Caught-In/Between (7.3%), and Electrocutions.

Multi-Channel Deterrence & IoT
Sirens, Telegram & Weather 08 / 10

Audible Sirens, Instant Telegram & IoT Weather AI

Multi-channel escalation: Physical frequency siren tones, spoken voice warnings, mobile alerts, and heat stress monitoring.

🔊 Acoustic Siren & TTS
Dual-Engine Audio Sentry
  • 18+ Frequency Tones: Distinct acoustic profiles for fire warbles, air horn tests, drop zones, and harnesses.
  • Text-to-Speech (TTS): Clear spoken directives (e.g. "Alert: No helmet in Zone 1").
  • Async Thread Queue: Zero blocking of video inference during active audio speech playback.
  • Soft-Mute Overrides: Quick mute toggles from command center.
📲 Instant Push Notifications
Telegram Bot Alert Dispatch
  • High-Resolution Photo Evidence: Sends the exact violation snapshot with bounding boxes to managers.
  • Context Rich Telemetry: Includes Zone ID, Severity rating (HIGH/CRITICAL), and exact timestamp.
  • Remote EHS Dispatch: Safety officers receive instant mobile notifications anywhere on or off site.
  • 1-Click Connectivity Test: Instant test alert verification via dashboard.
🌡️ NOAA Heat Stress Advisory
Real-Time Weather & Heat AI
  • Open-Meteo IoT Integration: Live ambient temperature, humidity, and wind velocity tracking.
  • NOAA Heat Index Scoring: Evaluates thermal heat stress risk (LOW, MODERATE, HIGH, CRITICAL).
  • Work-Rest Advisories: Automatically suggests mandatory hydration breaks for heavy workers.
  • High Wind & Rain Safety: Flags crane lifting shutdowns and wet slip hazards.
⚡ Triple Layer Deterrence: (1) On-Site Audible Siren + (2) Spoken Voice TTS Broadcast + (3) Instant Telegram Mobile Photo Dispatch.
